authority: Kew POWO/WCVP direct accepted-name and infraspecific pages; IPNI and World Flora Online where POWO direct page temporarily inaccessible
scope: Name, author, spelling, rank, genus/family, synonym/homonym and identity cautions only; no specimen ID, county nativity, photos, learner or publication edits
recovery_preflight: Prior Oxalis stricta batch 085 and Physalis cinerascens batch 104 found published despite historical handoff status; Grindelia papposa, Oenothera macrocarpa missouriensis and Sapindus saponaria vsr. Drummondii already reconciled in current Master Pool/Overrides. No eligible unpublished unclaimed taxonomy recovery needed from inspected handoffs.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts var. melanthera, var. occidentalis, var. scopulorum. Tradescantia virginiana var. occidentalis Britton is homotypic synonym; var. typica not validly published. No variety can be inferred from species-only source.
records.concept_action: Keep species-rank concept; preserve historical names as aliases, do not assign varieties.

records.synonym_note: Accepted Tragia betonicifolia Nutt. (1835) is distinct from illegitimate later homonym Tragia betonicifolia (Klotzsch) Müll.Arg. (1865), which POWO places under Tragia leucandra. Exact author required.
records.concept_action: Keep Nuttall species; do not map Klotzsch homonym to Texas species; prior PASS/range evidence untouched.

records.synonym_note: Tragia nepetifolia var. ramosa is homotypic synonym of T. ramosa. Historical Tragia ramosa var. leptophylla is instead homotypic synonym of independently accepted Tragia leptophylla; alternate historical treatments subsumed leptophylla in ramosa.
records.concept_action: Keep T. ramosa and T. leptophylla separate; do not infer identity from historical variety usage.

records.synonym_note: POWO currently recognizes THREE accepted subspecies: desertorum, dubius, major. Earlier source-pool note says two; this is outdated. Historical Tragopogon major subsp. dubius and T. pratensis subsp. dubius are homotypic synonyms.
records.concept_action: Correct prior accepted-subspecies count from two to three in name evidence; preserve species rank and prior range decisions.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts six subspecies: macrorrhizum, nevadense, ochranthum, orphanideum, prostratum, repens. Amoria repens is a homotypic synonym; no source subspecies established.
records.concept_action: Keep species-rank source and all infraspecifics unassigned.

records.synonym_note: Ulmus pumila Walter is an illegitimate later homonym and synonym of U. alata; Ulmus pumila L. is a separate accepted species. Author-sensitive synonym mapping only.
records.concept_action: Preserve U. alata and U. pumila L. as distinct; do not merge by epithet.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts three varieties: dentata, lancifolia, longibracteata; Helianthus dentatus Cav. is a homotypic synonym. Species-rank source lacks variety identity.
records.concept_action: Keep species rank; no automatic infraspecific determination.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts V. missouriensis; Viola sororia var. missouriensis is homotypic synonym. Historical authors variably included southern Viola langloisii, but current specialist treatment distinguishes them; specimen/photo identity not checked.
records.concept_action: Keep Missouri violet species distinct from V. langloisii and V. sororia; preserve previous source evidence.
